# HubSpot — HubSpot for Startups

Tiered discount on net-new Professional or Enterprise HubSpot products: 90% off year one for VC-funded or partner-affiliated startups, or 30% off year one via approved entrepreneurial organizations, tapering in later years.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📣 Marketing & Growth](../categories/marketing.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **When it ends** | Tier one: "Get 50% off in the second year and 25% off in year three". Tier two: "Get 15% off year two". Standard pricing applies afterwards. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90% off year one | — | Raised Pre-seed, Seed or Series A funding, but not Series B or later | A partner introduction is effectively needed |
| 30% off year one | — | Associated with one of our approved entrepreneurial organizations | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Series B and later companies (for the 90% tier)
- Products other than net-new Professional or Enterprise level products
